item: Windows: console close, logoff, shutdown and sleep are listened for
summary: Closing the console window, logging off or shutting down on Windows now takes the normal clean shutdown path, and the app writes its log back (a quick passive checkpoint) just before the PC goes to sleep. The OS only waits a few seconds, so a very large log may still be recovered at the next start. Field bundle 2026-11-07 F7.
